title: Oura Ring hero
description: A calm, window-tall photo hero on warm sand: a light, narrow editorial-serif title on two lines, a short grotesk lede and one electric-blue pill. Desktop sets the copy left and vertically centred beside the photo's subject; phones stack it centred at the bottom of the screen over the photo.
notes: sized by the window: 100svh less the 52px announcement strip, so strip + hero make one screen
the photo slot fills the hero (cover); empty, it is a sand placeholder; pick a photo whose subject sits right (desktop) and top (phones)
leaves the top 90px for the header bar that floats over it
no motion in the original's hero
